summary.ja: Poisson方程式の弱形式を、連続区分線形要素で離散化する。公開例は1次元区間と単位正方形の三角形分割で、剛性・整合質量行列を組み立て、非零Dirichlet値も消去できる。
summary.en: Discretize the weak Poisson problem with continuous piecewise-linear elements. The examples assemble stiffness/consistent-mass matrices on an interval and a triangulated unit square, including nonzero Dirichlet elimination.

code_mapping_scope: Related chapter modules and test files; not a claim that each test covers every named method.

references.label: Courant, R. (1943). Variational methods for the solution of problems of equilibrium and vibrations.
references.scope: Piecewise-linear trial functions on triangular subdivisions in a variational formulation; not a source for the atlas's CSR or GMRES implementation.

supports.ja: 三角形分割上の区分線形関数による変分近似を根拠付ける。現代的な疎行列・線形解法の出典とは区別する。
supports.en: Supports triangular piecewise-linear variational approximation, separately from the modern sparse solver implementation.

verification.locator: Section III, paragraph on linear functions on triangles, PDF p. 15 (reprint printed p. 2179); primary-paper reprint.

assumptions: Approximate constant-coefficient −Δu=f by continuous P1 Galerkin elements: uniform intervals on [0,1] or affine triangles from diagonally split unit-square cells.
Element formulas assemble stiffness and consistent mass; forcing uses four-point Gauss quadrature in 1D and product Gauss quadrature under a Duffy transform on triangles.
Dirichlet rows/columns are symmetrically eliminated and the system is solved by ILU(0)-preconditioned GMRES; smooth manufactured solutions support L2/H1 error evaluation.
units: Examples use dimensionless unit-length domains. With physical scaling, [f]=[u]/L²; stiffness and mass have geometric scales L^(d−2) and L^d in dimension d.
boundary_conditions: Dirichlet data apply at both interval endpoints or the full unit-square perimeter; defaults are zero and callbacks allow nonzero data. This example does not assemble Neumann/Robin boundary integrals.

limitations.ja: 汎用メッシュ生成や曲線要素、可変係数、混合要素の実装ではない。L2で2次・H1半ノルムで1次という既存の検査は滑らかな製造解と本メッシュの範囲であり、角の特異性や任意領域へ無条件に一般化しない。
limitations.en: Not a general mesh generator or implementation of curved elements, variable coefficients or mixed elements. Existing second-order L2 and first-order H1-seminorm tests concern smooth manufactured solutions on these meshes; do not generalize them unconditionally to corner singularities or arbitrary domains.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

assumptions_ja: 定係数の −Δu=f を連続P1 Galerkin空間で近似する。1次元は [0,1] の一様区間、2次元は単位正方形を対角分割したアフィン三角形。
剛性・整合質量行列は要素公式を使う。右辺は1次元4点Gauss求積、三角形はDuffy変換の積Gauss求積で評価する。
Dirichletの行と列を対称に消去し、ILU(0)付きGMRESで解く。滑らかな製造解のL2/H1誤差評価を備える。
units_ja: 公開例は無次元の長さ1の領域。物理尺度を付けるなら [f]=[u]/L²、次元dの剛性行列はL^(d−2)、質量行列はL^dの幾何学的尺度を持つ。
boundary_conditions_ja: 区間の両端、または単位正方形の全外周にDirichlet値を指定する。標準値は零で、関数により非零値も指定できる。Neumann/Robin境界積分は本例では組み立てない。

problem.ja: Dirichlet境界付きPoisson方程式 −Δu=f の弱解近似。
problem.en: Weak-solution approximation of −Δu=f with Dirichlet data.

variant.ja: 連続P1 Galerkin法、区間・アフィン三角形、整合質量行列と疎剛性組立て。
variant.en: Continuous P1 Galerkin on intervals/affine triangles with consistent mass and sparse stiffness assembly.

Comparing L2/H1 errors against a smooth known solution.
